source_caption:
Family Guy is an adult animated comedy created by Seth MacFarlane. It centers on the Griffin family living in Quahog—especially the clueless but loud Peter Griffin, his wife Lois, their kids, and their talking dog Brian.

The show is famous for its random cutaway jokes, dark humor, and heavy pop culture references. Instead of a strict storyline, episodes jump between absurd situations and satire, which gives it a fast, unpredictable style. Over the years, Family Guy has stayed popular for its edgy comedy and viral moments online.
